verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud-synced commerce and POS SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of choosing a storage region or residency for merchant data. The only storage-related item is the shopify.storage extension API for persisting data between sessions, which is a developer building block and has nothing to do with region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
